transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I just feel worn down almost all the time. It doesn't seem to matter if I get a full night's sleep or not, I'm just always tired. By the time I get through my work day and try to deal with the clutter around the house, I just have very little energy left for anything else.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

Yeah, I suppose I have. Most days there’s just this... low, gray mood running in the background. I mean, I can still go into the lab and talk to people, so I'm getting things done. But I don’t really feel light or excited about things anymore. Even stuff I usually like, like baking or taking out my telescope, just doesn't bring me that same feeling the way it used to.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not really. I'm trying to think of something, but... nothing really stands out right now. Like I said, baking and using my telescope used to be the main things I looked forward to. Now, I don't know, I just don't really get much out of anything. I mostly just go through the motions.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, pretty much. Like I was just saying, I really have lost interest. I just don't have the desire to do the things I used to like doing anymore, so I mostly just don't do them. It all just feels a bit flat.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been quite a while. I think... well, this sort of low baseline has been going on since shortly after we moved into our older house. So, that would be a little over two years ago now.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight over the past two years?
No, not really. My weight has stayed pretty steady. I haven't noticed any major changes up or down.
Have you had periods in the past two years where you felt better, similar to how you used to feel before moving into your older house?
No, not really. Um... I haven't really had any times where I felt like my old self again since then. It's just been pretty consistent... just this same kind of low feeling the whole time.
Have you had any periods where your low mood significantly improved for a while, only to return to this state again?

No, I haven't. Like I was just saying, it hasn't really lifted at all. I haven't had any stretches where things improved for a bit and then got worse again. It's just been that same steady, flat feeling the entire time.
Have you had any thoughts of not wanting to live or of harming yourself?
No, I haven't. Um, I don't have any thoughts about hurting myself or... not wanting to live. It's really just that steady low mood I mentioned, but nothing extreme like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you didn't feel this low mood?
No, not at all. Like I said, it's just been a constant thing. There hasn't been a break from it, definitely not for two months. It's just always there.
Have you ever experienced a period of significant depression before the one that started about two years ago?
No, I haven't. Before this started a couple of years ago, I didn't really have any issues with feeling depressed like this. It's just been these last two years.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago that lasted for less than two months?
No, not really. Um... before this all started two years ago, I didn't have any short spells of feeling depressed either. I felt pretty normal back then.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago?
No, I haven't. Like I mentioned a moment ago, I didn't have any issues with depression before this all started two years ago. I was fine before then.
Have you had any periods where your symptoms significantly improved for at least two months before returning to this low mood?
No, it hasn't ever really lifted like that. It's just been a steady, low feeling this whole time. I haven't had any breaks from it where I felt better for a couple of months.
Have you had any episodes of depression that lasted for at least two weeks before the one that started two years ago?
No, I haven't. Like I said, before this all started two years ago, I didn't have any issues with feeling depressed at all. It really just began then and hasn't gone away.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago that you haven't mentioned yet?
No, um... I really don't have anything else to add about that. Like I've been saying, I was completely fine before two years ago. There weren't any other episodes that I'm forgetting or leaving out.
Have you had any episodes of depression that lasted for at least two weeks before the one that started two years ago?

No. I think you actually just asked me that, but... no, I haven't. Like I said, I never had any two-week periods of feeling like this before the current issue started two years ago. I was totally fine before then.
Have you had any episodes of depression that lasted for less than two years before the one that started two years ago?

No... I really haven't. I feel like we're covering the same ground a bit, but honestly, there was nothing before two years ago. No short episodes, no long ones, nothing like that. I just didn't have any issues with feeling depressed until this current thing started.
Have you had any episodes of depression before the one that started two years ago that lasted for less than two years?

Um, I'm pretty sure you just asked me that again. But... no, I haven't. Like I've been saying, there were no episodes at all before two years ago, regardless of how long they lasted. I was completely fine before this started.
Have you had more than one episode of depression in your lifetime?
No, just this one. I mean, it's been going on for two years, but it's just the one continuous thing. Like I said, I didn't have any issues before this started.
